title: Ôn tập: a casual conversation with particles

segments.script: [EN: Quick review. Say how much, or how many —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bao nhiêu] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say one —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: một] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say two —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: hai] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say three —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: ba] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say four —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: bốn] [PAUSE 0.5s] [EN: Say five —] [PAUSE 4s] [VI: năm] [EN: Good.]

[EN: Let's drill.
